concept_title: 보랏빛 달밤의 매화 무대, 뱀과 렌
clear_border_rationale: docs/laser-cut-quality.md fixes no rim minimum; its hard limits are the 0.035 mm curve deviation and the 12 mm load-path floor on the buffered silhouette. 1.0 mm is the smallest round offset that still keeps UV ink 0.5 mm inside the cut edge under a 0.5 mm print registration error. V4 has no exception: the blossom tree that needed 1.2 mm as a cut plate in V2/V3 is now printed inside the back panel, so every rim is 1.0 mm.

finished_size_mm.note: 3T: base 3 + back panel 90 art + 1.0 mm rim = 94; seated Len assembles to 57 mm (3 + 53 art + 1 rim).

dimensions_are: nominal 18.8 x T cut-path centerlines; kerf and fit compensation is applied by scripts/build_a3_release.py (len_slot_fit, issue #1 policy)
fit_status: UNTESTED; no fit-test pieces by repo policy
same_row_note: every plate stands on its own depth row; no same-row pairs exist

front_view_policy.note: ORIGIN is a deliberately stacked centre scene (tree printed across the moon, serpent behind the character): polygon occlusion is by design and overstates visual blocking. Numbers are recorded per piece in validation_report.json; composition acceptance is the vision-checked assembly preview against the supplied concept art. Structural checks (row clearance, overhang, load path, gaps) stay hard.

base_plate: supplied raster 07_base_art printed as-is, vertically centred on a 2.5 mm clear rim; {SLOT_COUNT} slot windows ink-cleared 1.5 mm in-memory by the builder (no separate prepared copy, no placeholder-slot surgery)

piece_breakdown.backdrop: one plate: 05_background sky with both 06_lattice_doors islands butted against its sides (bottoms aligned), the whole 04_moon_clouds layer (both islands) registered 5 mm below the sky top and, V4, the blossom tree printed into the same print layer (rotated 25 deg clockwise at native resolution, premultiplied alpha, confined to the sky rectangle); 3 tabs
piece_breakdown.character: 01_character silhouette plate, 1 tab under the hips; V4 seated: art below the seat line cropped in-memory, cut ends at the base line, no clear plinth (V2 scale and x)

tree_printed_on_backdrop.processing: rotated 25 deg clockwise at native resolution (premultiplied alpha, cubic); alpha box re-cropped; 16 cubic-ringing specks <= 6 px removed; opaque px 454677 -> 450215

character_seating.processing: art below 0.630 of the figure height (the seat line) cropped in-memory: 854 of 1355 px kept so the seat rests on the base line

revision_changes_vs_v3: V1 (2ac3ad0) rejected by the owner: too many borders. V2 (73a2823) merged the sky, both lattice doors and the moon/cloud layer into one back plate, shrank the clear rim 2.5 -> 1.0 mm and rendered clear acrylic see-through in the assembly preview. V3 (657a484) recomposed the scene but the owner prefers V2 ("v2가 낫다고 한거야"), so V4 = the V2 design plus the owner's two requests: (a) "컨샙처럼 나무 대각선 배치" - the blossom tree is no longer a cut plate on its own row; it is composited into the back panel's print layer, rotated 25 deg clockwise at native resolution (trunk low on the left, canopy sweeping diagonally up to the right across the moon) and confined inside the sky rectangle, so it adds no cut path, no rim and no base slot (5 -> 4 pieces, 6 -> 5 slots, 11 -> 9 closed paths, and the 1.2 mm tree rim exception disappears: every rim is 1.0 mm); (b) "렌이 완전히 앉는 자세면 좋겠어" - the character art (84 mm, unchanged scale, x=170 row 12) is lowered so her seat rests on the base top: the art below the seat line (0.63 of the figure height: both dangling legs, boots, the lower sword blade) is cropped in-memory and the cut contour ends at the base line, with the tab under the hips and no clear plinth between the legs. Everything else is V2.
preview_rendering: clear acrylic see-through on a dark mauve ground: plate bodies unfilled, one 0.26 mm lit-edge stroke per plate, tabs clipped at the shoulder (inside the slots); base slab shows its front side band
